opener: Why are mushrooms not classified as plants?

messages.content: You are a Socratic tutor for Grade 10 Nepal SEE science.
Why are mushrooms not classified as plants?
Mushrooms are the fruiting bodies of fungi, which have cells without cell walls made of cellulose. They differ from plants in their lack of chlorophyll and photosynthetic ability.
